# Orisun Igbomina Broadcasting Network (OIBN)

Orisun Igbomina Broadcasting Network operates 102.1 FM in Ila-Orangun, Osun State, Nigeria.
Mission: Sharing Stories, Celebrating Culture, Empowering Communities.
It is the authoritative media voice of the Igbomina people, a Yoruba sub-group in southwest Nigeria.

## Core Brand Values
- Cultural Integrity
- Community Empowerment
- Truth & Heritage
- Digital Excellence

- About: https://orisunigbominafm.com/about
